name: Shellfish (crustaceans and bivalve molluscs — shrimp, crab, lobster, clams, oysters, mussels; not canned)
scope_note: Shellfish (crustaceans — shrimp, crab, lobster; and bivalve molluscs — clams, oysters, mussels), fresh or frozen, not canned. Lead and cadmium bind the stricter crustacean 500 across the whole subcategory; inorganic arsenic binds the EU crabs/prawns/shrimps 100; total mercury binds the crustaceans/molluscs general 500. MeHg bounded by tHg; total Cr binds HK 1000 (crustaceans and oysters); Ni/Al screened; Sn/Cr-VI not-material. Cephalopods are certified in their own subcategory; canned shellfish route to the canned-seafood subcategory.

Pb.basis: edible portion, wet weight. Crustacean lead 500 is the strictest sovereign covering a member of this subcategory; bivalve molluscs carry a looser 1500 ceiling, so certification holds the whole subcategory to the stricter crustacean 500.

Cd.basis: edible portion, wet weight. Crustacean cadmium 500 (EU 2023/915 and concurring sovereigns); the looser bivalve/gastropod cadmium (1000-2000) is not adopted.

tAs.basis: edible portion, wet weight; total arsenic 1000 (Singapore/Paraguay/AU-NZ molluscs).

iAs.basis: edible portion, wet weight; inorganic arsenic. EU Reg. 2025/1891 crabs and crab-like crustaceans iAs 100 is the strictest applicable species-specific line; other-crustaceans 200 and bivalve-other 500 are looser and not adopted.

tHg.basis: edible portion, wet weight; total mercury. EU 2023/915 crustaceans/molluscs general 500 (Costa Rica concurs).

MeHg.rationale: Methylmercury is bounded by total mercury (MeHg <= tHg). The binding total-mercury ceiling (500) is stricter than the lowest applicable sovereign methylmercury ML for crustaceans/molluscs (GSO crustaceans MeHg 1000), so passing tHg guarantees MeHg compliance; no separate methylmercury ceiling is published. Audit-affirmed (2026-08-14).
MeHg.reference_method: Total-mercury screen; reflex MeHg speciation cannot exceed the tHg ceiling.
MeHg.regulatory_basis: Bounded by the total-Hg crustaceans/molluscs ceiling (EU 2023/915, 500); no sovereign MeHg ML sits below it
MeHg.jurisdictions_checked: EU; GSO; US-FDA; MX; TH; HK

Ni.rationale: No jurisdiction sets a nickel ML for crustaceans or molluscs (EU 2024/1987 nickel is plant-food/seaweed only). Screened rather than assigned a mis-based number.
Ni.reference_method: Total-nickel screen (ICP-MS); no sovereign shellfish Ni ML.
Ni.trigger: periodic nickel screen; flag on anomalous elevation

Sn.rationale: Fresh/frozen shellfish has no tinplate contact; tin is a can-migration analyte and no sovereign sets a non-canned shellfish tin matrix limit (audit-affirmed). If canned, certified under the canned-seafood subcategory.
Sn.reference_method: Packaging control (non-tinplate); ICP-MS per-lot screen; escalate to canned-seafood Sn if tinplate-packed.
Sn.regulatory_basis: No non-canned shellfish Sn ML; canned-seafood Sn limits are can-only
Sn.jurisdictions_checked: Codex CXS 193; EU; US-FDA; MX; CR; HK

Al.rationale: No credible regulator sets an aluminium contaminant ML for seafood; aluminium in shellfish is background, managed by intake vs the EFSA/JECFA TWI.
Al.reference_method: Total-aluminium screen (ICP-MS); managed by TWI; no per-food seafood contaminant ML.
Al.trigger: periodic aluminium screen; flag on anomalous elevation

Cr.basis: edible portion, wet weight; total chromium. HK Cap 132V sets total-Cr 1000 for both crabs/prawns/shrimps and oysters, covering the crustacean and bivalve members of this subcategory; India all-fishery 12000 is looser.

Cr-VI.rationale: Cr-VI is bounded by the total-chromium government limit (HK crustaceans/oysters 1000); no Cr-VI food ML exists and Cr(VI) is reduced to Cr(III) in a reducing animal-tissue matrix. Rebuttable if a routed source reports hexavalent chromium in shellfish.
Cr-VI.reference_method: Bounded by total-chromium government limit; reflex Cr-VI speciation only on anomalously elevated total chromium.
Cr-VI.regulatory_basis: No Cr-VI food ML anywhere; bounded by total chromium (HK 1000)
Cr-VI.jurisdictions_checked: EU; Codex; US-FDA; HK; EPA (water only)

method: HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default; explicit-id lookup; MeHg speciation-bounded by tHg on animal seafood; seaweed on dry-matter basis)
